title: Eleven Years in a Laboratory
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）　|　核心词汇：heart　|　正文 375 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 heart 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Dr Reyes spent eleven years on a ① heart that was not anybody's. Heart, she said once, is only a pump with opinions. It beat in a glass tank in a room without windows, and it belonged to a pig, and it was the only thing in the building that everybody went to look at. The ② heart of the problem, she explained on my first day, is that a cell will do almost anything if you feed it, and almost nothing if you tell it to.

I was nineteen and employed to change the fluid. The tank, the pump and the tubing were the ③ heart of the apparatus, and the apparatus was the size of a small car. What the machine did was imitate a body: it warmed the fluid, it pushed it, and it ④ heartened nobody, because a machine cannot. What kept eleven people working for eleven years was not the machine.

She had a rule about language. We were never to say the tissue was happy. She had no ⑤ heart for sentiment. 'A heart does not have moods,' she said, 'and the moment you forget that, you will start writing papers about its feelings.' She was ⑥ heartily disliked by two of the eleven, both of whom left, and both of whom are now professors somewhere warmer.

The ⑦ heart of her argument, which she published in 2004 and which nobody read for six years, was that the cells were not surviving on the fluid at all. They were surviving on the movement — on being pushed, which is what a body does to a ⑧ heart about sixty times a minute, every day, without being asked.

By the fifth year nobody's heart was in it any more. I left in 2006 and became a teacher, which is a different kind of the same work. She died in 2015, and the tank was switched off, and I have never been able to find out what happened to the pump, and my heart went with her. What I learned ⑨ by heart from her was not a fact. It was a habit: ask what a thing is being pushed by, and ask it before you ask what it is made of. The rest I have forgotten, ⑩ heart and soul.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 核心；关键；要点（the heart of）
C. n. 中心；中央部位
F. 固定搭配：by heart 凭记忆；熟记
G. 固定搭配：heart and soul 全心全意；完全地
H. n. 心肠；情感；感情（与理智相对）

items.q: eleven years on a heart that was not anybody's
were the heart of the apparatus
She had no heart for sentiment
She was heartily disliked by two of the eleven
what a body does to a heart
What I learned by heart from her
The rest I have forgotten, heart and soul

answers.why: 指那颗不属于任何人的“心脏”，即玻璃缸里猪的心脏。
the heart of the problem 意为“问题的核心、关键”。
指装置的“中心部位”，说缸、泵、管路是整套设备的核心部分。
hearten 作动词，意为“使振奋、鼓舞”，说机器做不到鼓舞人心。
have no heart for 意为“对……没有兴趣／同情”，说她毫不多愁善感。
heartily 作副词，意为“极其、非常”，说十一个人里有两人非常不喜欢她。
the heart of her argument 意为“她的论点的核心”。
同样指心脏器官，说身体每分钟大约推动心脏六十次。
by heart 意为“凭记忆、熟记”，说我从她那里记住的不是一个事实。
heart and soul 意为“完全地、全心全意地”，此处带自嘲：其余的全忘了。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 问题的核心是：喂它，细胞什么都肯做。（the heart of）
缸、泵和管路是整套装置的核心部分。（heart）
十一个人里有两人极其不喜欢她。（heartily）
她论点的核心是：细胞靠的不是液体而是被推动。（the heart of）
我从她那里熟记的不是事实，而是一个习惯。（by heart）
answers: The heart of the problem is that a cell will do almost anything if you feed it.
The tank, the pump and the tubing were the heart of the apparatus.
She was heartily disliked by two of the eleven.
The heart of her argument was that the cells were surviving on the movement, not the fluid.
What I learned by heart from her was not a fact but a habit.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 heart 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Dr Reyes spent eleven years on a heart that was not anybody's.
The heart of the problem, she said, is that a cell will do almost anything if you feed it.
The tank, the pump and the tubing were the heart of the apparatus, and the machine heartened nobody.
'A heart does not have moods,' she said, and she was heartily disliked for saying so.
The heart of her argument was that the cells survived on being pushed, as a body pushes a heart.
What I learned by heart from her was a habit: ask what a thing is being pushed by.
